_note: Labelled A/B set for increment-1 done-when. Queries are realistic paraphrases with ~0 content-word overlap with their target note, so a lexical (description-string) baseline must miss and only semantic recall can win.

notes.name: hosting
notes.description: Production runs on Coolify and Hetzner. Not Vercel.

notes.name: secrets
notes.description: Use the secret CLI backed by the OS keyring. Never print a value.

notes.name: testing
notes.description: Prefer pytest over unittest. Write the failing test first.

notes.name: packages
notes.description: JS uses pnpm. Python uses uv. Avoid npm and pip.

notes.name: database
notes.description: App data lives in Postgres via Supabase. Local dev in Docker.

notes.name: font
notes.description: Skip Inter and Roboto. Choose an opinionated typeface.

notes.name: commits
notes.description: Conventional commit format. No AI attribution unless asked.

notes.name: deploy
notes.description: A push to main triggers a Coolify webhook rebuild.

notes.name: dns
notes.description: Domain is on Cloudflare, DNS-only, pointing at the server IP.

notes.name: email
notes.description: Transactional mail goes out through Resend.

notes.name: language
notes.description: Reply in the user's own language: Russian to Russian, English to English.

notes.name: money
notes.description: Represent currency with Decimal. Never use float for money.
